channel.title: DIY Home & Yard Project Calculators
channel.description: How much concrete, gravel, mulch, topsoil, or paint to buy, worked out before you go to the store.

item.title: How Many Bags of Concrete for a 10x10 Slab? (Free Calculator)
item.description: A 10 x 10 ft patio slab 4 inches thick takes 33.33 cubic feet (1.23 cubic yards) of concrete: 62 bags of 80 lb mix or 82 bags of 60 lb mix with 10% extra for waste. Enter your own slab, round pad, or post holes to get cubic yards and bag counts. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Mulch Calculator: How Much Mulch for 200 Square Feet?
item.description: Mulching 200 square feet of garden beds 3 inches deep takes 50 cubic feet, which is 1.85 cubic yards, 25 bags of 2 cu ft, or 17 bags of 3 cu ft. Enter your bed sizes, tree rings, and any old mulch already there to see how much to buy. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: How Much Soil for a 4x8 Raised Bed? (Free Topsoil Calculator)
item.description: A 4 x 8 ft raised bed filled 10 inches deep needs about 29 cubic feet of soil with 10% added for settling: 20 bags of 1.5 cu ft or 15 bags of 2 cu ft (1.09 cubic yards in bulk). Enter your own beds or lawn area to get cubic yards and bag counts. Free, no sign-up.
